channel.title: CapMeter — Claude & Codex limit changes
channel.description: Dated, source-linked records of changes to Claude and Codex usage limits, plans and pricing.

item.title: ChatGPT and Codex will share one usage allowance starting in December
item.description: From December, Plus, Pro and Business plans will draw ChatGPT and Codex usage from one shared, token-based allowance. OpenAI has not given an exact date or size.

item.title: Codex on ChatGPT Pro currently has no five-hour limit
item.description: OpenAI's Codex pricing documentation says Pro plans currently have no five-hour limit. Plus and Standard Business still have one, and weekly limits may apply.

item.title: Claude's Max 20x plan is now called Ultra
item.description: Max 20x has been renamed Ultra at the same $200 a month. Verified Ultra accounts have no five-hour limit and get 10 times Pro usage every week.

item.title: Claude Code weekly limits are now permanently 25% higher
item.description: Anthropic's 50% Claude Code weekly limit promotion ended on September 13, 2026. Since September 14, weekly limits are 25% above the pre-promotion level.

item.title: Claude limit resets: one-time refills for your five-hour or weekly limit
item.description: Eligible Claude plans occasionally get a one-time limit reset that refills the five-hour limit, the weekly limit or weekly Fable usage, used from Settings → Usage.

item.title: October 7, 2026: some Claude organizations were wrongly paused at their spend limit
item.description: Anthropic's status page recorded an issue that wrongly paused some organizations for reaching their spend limit, refusing requests across the API, Claude.ai and Claude Code.
